title: motion_strip.odin adds a third Demo_Replay construction site + stepping-loop copy, defeating the struct's anti-drift design on the strip path
detail: A future run-setup directive must be threaded through three inline cfg builders; forgetting the strip's copy compiles fine and silently renders a wrong evidence timeline. The PR's N15 mitigation ("drift would fail harness run") only covers the shared procs (demo_apply_setup/lower_intents), not this cfg copy.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared `demo_replay_of(demo: ^Demo) -> Demo_Replay` builder used by run_demo, load_demo_replay, and run_motion_strip (ownership aside, the strip already defers the same deletes); track the loop-extraction as the flagged harness-cleanup story.

title: The interp-alpha derivation exists in two implementations (app accum-based vs strip wall-ms-based) with no shared definition or equivalence pin
evidence:
app/main.odin:463-465:
		interp_alpha: f32 = 1.0
		if app.mode == .Run {
			interp_alpha = f32(min(app.accum / tick_seconds, 1.0))
		} — vs harness/motion_strip.odin:162-163:
					alpha = f32(t - win_start) / f32(tick_ms)
					alpha = min(alpha, 1.0)
detail: The evidence verb claims to prove the app's glide but re-implements the alpha semantic. If the app's convention changes (e.g. render-ahead, clamping rule), the strips silently diverge from shipped behavior; motion_test pins packet_interp_pos endpoints, not this derivation.
recommended_fix: Hoist one `interp_alpha_of(elapsed, tick_len) -> f32` proc into app/render next to packet_interp_pos, call it from both sites, and pin it with a unit test.

title: measure_packet_motion.py hardcodes the catalog packet color and exits 0 on total tracking failure — evidence pipeline can silently go vacuous
evidence:
tools/measure_packet_motion.py:27:
BODY = (90, 98, 112)  # email packet body color (data/packet_types.json) — and 118-125:
    else:
        print("mean jump when moving: no moving frames in either strip")
    return 0 — verified by running `--xmax 1`: output "lost track (packet absent): BEFORE=3  AFTER=3 / mean jump when moving: no moving frames in either strip", exit=0. data/packet_types.json carries "color_rgba": [90, 98, 112, 255] (the ODN-5 catalog source).
detail: The tracker restates a catalog value (ODN-5 single-source spirit); a palette/catalog change degrades every frame to `lost` while the tool still exits success, so the documented reproduce flow produces vacuous evidence without a failure signal.
recommended_fix: Exit non-zero when zero frames were tracked in either strip; ideally read the email color from data/packet_types.json instead of restating the constant.

title: Leftover dead code and an unfinished "hmm" comment committed in motion_test.odin
evidence:
app/render/motion_test.odin:241-242:
	pos := node_screen(&v, topo.node_pos[1]) // hmm — compute the actual position

detail: A computed-then-discarded binding plus an authoring note sits in the new gate-2 test file; it reads as unfinished and the dead `pos` invites confusion with the real `snap` computation two lines below.
